name: HWA 3 hot-water boiler, automatic-fill, 230 V
note: Automatic fixed-water mode selected; manual-fill option is not a separate row. Use supplied food-approved inlet hose and check the water pressure on the appliance identification plate; numerical range/connector size are not published in the linked HWA3 instructions. Empty via tap and tilt only after cooling; drip tray is manually emptied, no fixed waste connection. Install on dry, level, heat-resistant support near an accessible earthed outlet, indoors at 0-40 C. Retain lid, tap, cable and hose access; no numerical clearance stated. Published overall dimensions include supplied drip tray; no optional pedestal.
